title: 回放停止在目标点
premise: 恢复目标和时区明确，核对日志连续性与回放停止记录。
listeningTask: 辨别日志归档可用、回放完成和允许接入应用。

lines.en: Archived WAL covers the whole required chain. Segments remain available through two fifteen.
lines.zh: 归档WAL覆盖所需完整链，日志段可用到两点十五分。

lines.en: Did replay stop at the requested point? Availability beyond it doesn't change scope.
lines.zh: 回放停在请求目标点了吗？后面的日志可用不改变范围。

lines.en: Yes, logs show the recovery target reached. We inspected that before test access.
lines.zh: 是，日志显示达到恢复目标，开放测试访问前检查过。

lines.en: Just to confirm, isolation remained intact, right? No application production endpoint was changed.
lines.zh: 确认一下，隔离始终保持，对吧？没有改任何应用生产端点。

lines.en: Let me tail the log myself. I see no missing segment warnings.
lines.zh: 我自己盯日志，没有看到缺日志段警告。

lines.en: The backup manifest checks passed before replay. Timeline and target settings are attached.
lines.zh: 回放前备份清单校验通过，时间线和目标设置已附。

lines.en: Was recovery left paused or ended? I need the current server state.
lines.zh: 恢复还暂停着还是已结束？需要明确服务器当前状态。

lines.en: It ended under the reviewed drill procedure. Test access opened after boundary checks.
lines.zh: 按评审过的演练流程结束，边界检查后开放测试访问。

lines.en: So a smoke test can run. That still doesn't prove every row.
lines.zh: 那可以跑冒烟测试，但仍不能证明每一行正确。

lines.en: Okay, maybe summarize those checks next. Keep completed steps distinct from acceptance.
lines.zh: 好，接下来总结检查吧，把已完成步骤和验收分开。

scene: 恢复目标和时区明确，核对日志连续性与回放停止记录。
accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）
